content: वन्दनम् [वन्द्-ल्युट्] .²1 Salutation, obeisance. .²2 Reverence, adoration. .²3 Obeisance paid to a Brāhmaṇa <ab>&c.</ab> (by touching his feet). .²4 Praising, extolling. .²5 A custaneous eruption, scrofula. .{@-ना@} .²1 Worship, adoration. .²2 Praise. .{@-नी@} .²1 Worship, adoration. .²2 Praise. .²3 Solicitation. .²4 A drug for reviving the dead.
